prBodyNotes: **Order:** merging rebuilds the image and changes its digest; merge all open updates here before rolling a new digest out.
**Manual:** update `BW_SHA256` in this PR (command in the Dockerfile); the build fails until it matches.

customManagers.description: Bitwarden CLI version (# renovate: comment). BW_SHA256 must be bumped by hand in the same PR; the build fails until it is.
